title: A module equivalence descends along compatible coefficient maps
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I→CommRing a diagram, and (C,ι) a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix i∈I and an F(i)-algebra B. Let M be a finitely presented B-module and L a finitely presented Q-module for a commutative ring Q [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. For j≥i set B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i)}B and Y=C⊗_{F(i)}B. Give Y its B-algebra structure by right tensor inclusion and its Q-algebra structure by a specified ring map q_C:Q→Y. Suppose Y⊗_Q L≃_Y Y⊗_B M. Fix k≥i and ring maps q_j:Q→B_j for all j≥k, compatible with all transitions B_j→B_l and with the coprojections B_j→Y (whose composites with q_j equal q_C). Then there exists j₀≥k such that for every j≥j₀, with the Q-action on B_j induced by q_j and its B-action by right tensor inclusion, B_j⊗_Q L≃_{B_j}B_j⊗_B M. The specified limit isomorphism need not itself be recorded in the conclusion. There are no finite-presentation assumptions on B as an algebra or on Q as a ring, and no flatness assumptions.

proof.text: Construct on the upper tail J={j:k≤j} the rings E_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i)}B, their transition ring maps f_jl and their maps g_j to Y=C⊗_{F(i)}B. Verify identity, composition and compatibility by induction on tensors. Apply tensorTailColimitElementwise with module B to obtain representatives of Y and eventual zero of the E_j.

At the initial tail stage k, put P=E_k⊗_Q L and N=E_k⊗_B M. Mathlib finite-presentation base-change instances make both finitely presented E_k-modules. Compatibility hqC and right tensor inclusion give the scalar towers Q→E_k→Y and B→E_k→Y. Tensor cancellation transports eM to an equivalence Y⊗_{E_k}P≃Y⊗_{E_k}N.

Apply exists_stage_equiv_of_elementwise_colimit to the raw ring system and P,N. At the returned stage j₀, hq and compatibility of right inclusion supply the scalar towers; the proved private helper cancel_comparison identifies the two iterated tensors with E_j₀⊗_Q L and E_j₀⊗_B M.

For every later original index j, base change the stage equivalence along f_j₀j. Apply cancel_comparison again using hq and right-inclusion compatibility. Proof irrelevance identifies the different witnesses of the inequalities used in the target statement. This proves the eventual conclusion without a poset reflection in this module.

theorem exists_eventually_compatible_module_equiv
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    {i : I} {B M : Type w} [CommRing B] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) B] [Module B M] [Module.FinitePresentation B M]
    (Q L : Type x) [CommRing Q] [AddCommMonoid L] [Module Q L]
    [Module.FinitePresentation Q L]
    (qC : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      Q →+* (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (eM : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra Q ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) := qC.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra B ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Nonempty (((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) ⊗[Q] L ≃ₗ[
        (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B] ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) ⊗[B] M))
    (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k)
    (q : ∀ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
      Q →+* (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (hqC : ∀ (j : I) (hkj : k ≤ j),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      let t : F.obj j →ₐ[F.obj i] c.pt :=
        { (c.ι.app j).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦ ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
            (c.w (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))) s }
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp
        (q j hkj) = qC)
    (hq : ∀ (j l : I) (hkj : k ≤ j) (hkl : k ≤ l) (hjl : j ≤ l),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans hkl))).hom.toAlgebra
      let t : F.obj j →ₐ[F.obj i] F.obj l :=
        { (F.map (homOfLE hjl)).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦ (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
            (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hik.trans hkj)) (homOfLE hjl)) s).symm }
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id (F.obj i) B)).toRingHom.comp
        (q j hkj) = q l hkl) :
    ∃ (j₀ : I) (hkj₀ : k ≤ j₀), ∀ (j : I) (h₀ : k ≤ j₀) (h₁ : j₀ ≤ j),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hik.trans (h₀.trans h₁)))).hom.toAlgebra
      let E := (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B
      letI : Algebra Q E := (q j (h₀.trans h₁)).toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra B E := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Nonempty (E ⊗[Q] L ≃ₗ[E] E ⊗[B] M)
